replacements.old: - [ ] Audit Free Energy Principle / active inference as a strongest-parent candidate for perception-learning-action unification.
replacements.new: - [x] Audit Free Energy Principle / active inference as a strongest-parent candidate for perception-learning-action unification. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae12-fep-audit-v1` AE12-1, AE12-8: on every registered dyadic world and observation the free-energy minimiser equals the exact Bayes posterior and the minimum equals the surprisal `-log2 P(o)` exactly (on `W_SPLIT` every observation has evidence `1/4`, so the minimum is exactly `2` bits), so the receipt emits the terminal `PARENT_SUFFICIENT` naming active inference as the owner of perception, with `novelty_claimed: false`.

replacements.old: - [ ] State exact assumptions needed for any claimed equivalence with Bayesian inference/predictive coding/control.
replacements.new: - [x] State exact assumptions needed for any claimed equivalence with Bayesian inference/predictive coding/control. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae12-fep-audit-v1` AE12-2, AE12-3, AE12-4: each assumption the claimed equivalence needs is paired with a registered world where dropping it breaks the equality: the mean-field restriction on `W_CORR` raises the minimum from `1` bit to `2` bits, an exact price of `1` bit; a swapped likelihood on `W_TRI_MIS` returns `(1/2, 0, 1/2)` where the true posterior is `(1/2, 1/2, 0)`; and on `W_AMB` the ambiguity term never sees the preference prior, so the expected-free-energy gap is exactly `1` bit for every preference distribution.

replacements.new: - [x] Include published technical counterexamples/criticisms; do not inherit universal FEP claims uncritically. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae12-fep-audit-v1` AE12-5: four published criticisms are each attached to a registered finite predicate that is evaluated exactly rather than cited: `MARKOV_BLANKET_EXISTS` is decided by exhaustive search over every partition into non-empty internal, blanket and external sets, holding on `SYS_MB_OK` with `4` admissible partitions and failing on `SYS_MB_FAIL` with `0`, while `FEP_EQUALS_BAYES_UNDER_RESTRICTED_FAMILY` and `EFE_RECOVERS_UTILITY_ORDERING` both evaluate false.

replacements.new: - [x] Construct finite discriminating tasks where GMI/CPC, rate-distortion control and an active-inference formulation differ. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae12-fep-audit-v1` AE12-6: on `W_DISC1` the expected free energies are `(1, 0, 1)` bits, so expected free energy chooses `a1`, cardinality-`1` rate-distortion control chooses `a0`, and across all `45` registered weight triples the CPC family reproduces neither pair of choices together; on `W_AGREE1` the expected free energies are `(1, 3/2, 3)` bits and all three principles choose `b0`, so the discrimination is a property of the world and not of the comparison.

replacements.new: - [x] Compare predictive and control behavior prospectively. — ✅ `gmi-833-ae-ae12-fep-audit-v1` AE12-4, AE12-7: the eight predictions were committed in `PROSPECTIVE_REGISTER_V1.json` before any executor blob existed and all eight are reported: `6` confirmed and `2` refuted with exact values, a single-stage attribution and the statement earned instead - the predicted expected-utility difference of `1/2` on `W_AMB` is in fact `0`, and the CPC family reaches `2` of the `3` actions of `W_DISC1` because `a2` is term-vector dominated with equal predictive loss `1/2`, equal control regret `1/2` and cost `2` against `1`.
